paper_contract.query_sampling: sample 10000 queries independently at every loop; exact paper RNG and overlap policy are not disclosed
paper_contract.positive_signal: document selected by a Browse/get_document action after Search
paper_contract.negative_signal: retrieved documents not selected for Browse
paper_contract.false_positive_filter: judge the post-browse reasoning and keep only RELEVANT
paper_contract.loop_update: re-encode corpus, recollect trajectories, rebuild pairs, continue training the current retriever

disclosed_unknowns: the paper does not disclose the random seed or overlap policy used when sampling 10K InfoSeekQA queries at each loop
the paper reports batch size 32 but does not state whether it is global or per-device; the default profile interprets it as a global simultaneous batch
the paper does not state whether optimizer state is continued or reset between flywheel iterations; this implementation updates from the current retriever but starts a fresh optimizer per loop
hard_boundaries: never read paper-flywheel outputs from competition preprocess/train/inference paths
never copy paper-flywheel checkpoints into ccir/models or ccir/submissions
never upload paper-flywheel checkpoints to Hugging Face or the competition platform
each loop must use a freshly encoded index and freshly collected trajectories from its current retriever
the low-memory profile is an engineering approximation and must never be reported as an exact paper hyperparameter reproduction
